name: Admin Document Gallery View
description: Toggle between list and gallery views on /panel/documents via the 'Lista'/'Galería' segmented control (data-testid doc-view-list / doc-view-grid). Gallery renders one card per document with a sanitized markdown mini-preview, client and date, ordered active-state episodes with open durations and a +N overflow badge, plus the same kebab 'Acciones' opening DocumentActionsSheet. Subfolder cards render first with dashed borders and act as drag-and-drop targets. The chosen mode persists in localStorage; on mobile the gallery is always used.
